media.title: Why Ramp Built Its Own Background Agent

title: Why We Built Our Own Background Agent
summary: Ramp explains why it built a background coding agent around complete development environments, repository context, internal tools, and end-to-end verification instead of relying on generic code generation alone. The design makes the environment and its feedback channels a first-class part of agent capability.
takeaway: Invest in reproducible environments and access to the same internal commands humans use; model quality cannot compensate for missing context or verification.
